terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.description: The rules for using PM Circle, joining the community and purchasing access.
terms.meta_description: Read the PM Circle terms and conditions for accounts, learning, exam practice, community participation and purchases.

sections.title: About these terms
sections.body: These terms govern access to PM Circle, a learning, practice and community service from ITQAN Consulting. By creating an account or using PM Circle, you agree to the terms that apply to your use. Our [Privacy Policy](/privacy) explains how information is handled.

sections.title: Accounts and eligibility
sections.body: Provide accurate account information, keep your credentials secure and tell us if you suspect unauthorised access. Use your own account and do not sell or share access. If you need parent or guardian consent under applicable law, obtain it before using the service.

sections.title: Plans, purchases and refunds
sections.body: Access depends on your plan, purchase or any offer shown at checkout. Before paying, review the total price, access period, included features, renewal terms if applicable, and cancellation and refund conditions. You can cancel a monthly plan at any time. Completed monthly plan payments are non-refundable, subject to any rights provided by law. See our [Refund Policy](/refund-policy) for cancellation and purchase support. Contact us with your order reference if there is a billing error or you cannot access what you purchased.

sections.title: Learning content and exam practice
sections.body: Courses, practice tests and feedback are for learning and preparation. Simulator scores are practice results. Passing an official exam, obtaining certification or securing employment depends on the relevant provider or employer. Certification names identify the exams being discussed. Any affiliation or endorsement will be stated where applicable.

sections.title: AI tools and career guidance
sections.body: AI suggestions, scores and sample answers can contain mistakes or miss context. Review them before relying on them or sharing them. For a résumé, use only descriptions and results you can verify. For interview practice and career guidance, use feedback to prepare and make your own decisions.

sections.title: Community rules and moderation
sections.body: Respect other members and follow the [Community Guidelines](/community). Do not post harassment, spam, misleading claims, leaked exam content, or personal information without permission. Do not impersonate others or misuse anonymous posting. We may review reports, restrict visibility or suspend access for misuse. Contact us to request review of a moderation decision.

sections.title: Your content and platform materials
sections.body: You retain rights to original content you submit. You give PM Circle permission to store, process and display it as needed to operate the features you use and honour your visibility settings. Submit only material you have the right to share. PM Circle learning and simulator materials are provided for personal use. Redistribution, resale or republishing requires permission unless applicable law allows it.

sections.title: Events and third-party services
sections.body: Event pages identify the organiser, eligibility and any registration requirements. Member-hosted and sponsored events may have additional rules. Check the event page before registering. External organisers and linked services are responsible for their own offers, content and terms. Sponsored placement identifies paid promotion where applicable.

sections.title: Service changes and account closure
sections.body: Features and content may change or be temporarily unavailable. We may restrict an account to address misuse, protect members or comply with law. If a change affects paid access, applicable purchase terms and consumer rights continue to apply. Contact us to request account closure.

sections.title: Consumer rights and disputes
sections.body: These terms apply subject to applicable law. Your mandatory consumer rights remain available. If there is a problem, contact us with the details so we can try to resolve it. If we cannot resolve it, you may use any complaint or dispute-resolution route available to you under applicable law.

sections.title: Updates and contact
sections.body: We will post revised terms here and notify members of material changes where required. For questions about an account, purchase, event or these terms, [contact ITQAN Consulting](/contact).

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How PM Circle handles your information and the choices available to you.
privacy.meta_description: How PM Circle handles your information and the choices available to you.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: PM Circle is a learning, practice and professional community from ITQAN Consulting. This policy describes how information is handled when you browse the site, create an account, use member features or contact us.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body:
- **Account and profile.** Name, email, account credentials or verification information, profile photo, and professional details you choose to add.
- **Learning and practice.** Courses, progress, practice answers, simulator attempts, scores, feedback and achievements.
- **Community and events.** Posts, comments, reactions, reports, event registrations and details requested on the registration form, such as contact information.
- **Career and AI tools.** Résumés and other files you upload, prompts, interview responses, and the feedback or drafts generated from them. If you choose voice input where offered, this can include audio or a transcript.
- **Purchases and support.** Plan or product purchased, transaction reference, billing details needed for the order and messages you send to support. Payment providers may collect payment information directly.
- **Technical information.** Device and browser details, IP address, activity logs, and cookie or browser storage information used to operate and protect the service.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body: We use information to verify accounts, provide features, save progress, score attempts, generate requested feedback, manage subscriptions and event registrations, respond to requests, and protect the service. We may also use activity information to understand which features are working and improve them. Where required, we ask for consent or provide a choice for optional uses.

sections.title: Profiles, community and event visibility
sections.body:
Choose what to share in your profile and check who can see a contribution before posting. Information you publish publicly can be viewed by visitors. Where the anonymous posting feature is available, other members see an anonymous label and authorised moderators can identify the author when handling reports or misuse.

For events, the registration form should identify the organiser and explain what details are shared for registration, event communications or attendance. An external organiser may handle its copy under its own privacy notice.

sections.title: AI features and automated feedback
sections.body:
When you request AI assistance, relevant material may be sent to the provider supporting that feature. This can include résumé text, interview responses or scenario answers. AI may also assist with feedback or moderation. Review results for accuracy and share only information you have permission to use.

We will identify provider handling, including retention and any model-training use, in the relevant feature notice where applicable. Contact us if you want to question an AI-assisted moderation decision or request a review.

sections.title: Who may receive information
sections.body: We may share the information needed to provide a service with hosting, email, analytics, payment, AI and other service providers, or with an event organiser as described at registration. We may also disclose information where required by law or to respond to fraud, abuse or a security incident. Some service providers may process information outside Bangladesh. Applicable safeguards depend on the service and the transfer.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
sections.body: We may use cookies or browser storage for sign-in, preferences and security. Optional analytics, where enabled, help us understand usage. You can manage browser storage in your browser settings and optional cookies through any controls provided on the site.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.body: We keep records for as long as needed for their purpose, including account access, learning history, support, billing and resolving disputes. Retention varies by type of record and applicable requirements. We use measures designed to protect information and restrict access to authorised people. Use a unique password and let us know if you suspect unauthorised access.

sections.title: Your choices and requests
sections.body: You can update profile information and visibility settings where those controls are available. Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion or a copy of your information, withdraw consent, or object to or restrict certain uses. To make a request, [contact ITQAN Consulting](/contact) and include the email linked to your account. We may verify your identity before acting on the request.

sections.title: Children’s privacy
sections.body: Children who need consent to use the service under applicable law should use it only with the required permission. If you believe a child provided personal information without the required consent, contact us so we can review it.

sections.title: Changes and contact
sections.body: We will post updates on this page and notify members of material changes where required. For a privacy question, data request or concern, [contact ITQAN Consulting](/contact). See also our [Terms and Conditions](/terms).
